display.purpose: The plate title on the front page; the docs h1 is a lighter cut of the same role.

headline.purpose: Sheet titles on the front page.

title.purpose: Wordmark, contents entries, previous and next, schedule row heads.

lede.purpose: The paragraph under a plate title, capped at 50ch.

body.purpose: All prose; 62ch on the front page, 44rem in the docs.

key.purpose: The key column, captions, tables, notes and the docs rail.

label.purpose: True small caps for running heads, column heads, room names and captions.

mono.purpose: Commands and config keys only, inside code.

motion.name: control-fill
motion.purpose: Hover and pressed fills on the install control, play and steppers.

motion.name: disc-light
motion.value: background-color 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out
motion.purpose: A callout disc lighting in the key, caption and plate.

motion.name: plate-light
motion.purpose: The screen, route, cloud and leaders changing colour as a step lights.

motion.name: travel
motion.purpose: The dotted sound route moving towards the Mac on step 2, reversed on step 7. Dash period 7.1 so the loop is seamless.

motion.name: travel-dash
motion.purpose: The cloud's dashed leader on step 5.

motion.name: sound
motion.purpose: The speech line on step 1 and the speaker arcs on step 7.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The plate's disc settling when it lights. All keyframes run only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Base size drops to 17px; tables stack.

breakpoints.name: plate-pans
breakpoints.purpose: The plate takes a 46rem minimum width and pans sideways.

breakpoints.name: book
breakpoints.purpose: The head splits, the walk gets its key column, the key and docs rail go sticky.

lineWeights.name: line
lineWeights.purpose: Ordinary line work, round caps and joins.

lineWeights.name: wall-outline
lineWeights.purpose: Ink outline on the brick walls; the cloud leader; the mic.

lineWeights.name: leader
lineWeights.purpose: Callout leaders at rest; 2 when lit.

components.name: Install control
components.description: The one action on the front page: copies npm install -g parlour and says so for 1.8s.
components.css: .ds-install { font: inherit; font-family: var(--serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c20); background: var(--plate, #fcfcfa); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1c20); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6rem; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-install:hover { background: var(--code-bg, #f1f1ec); } .ds-install:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slate, #3d5a80); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-install code { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-install-prompt { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: var(--ink-2, #55555e); } .ds-install-copied { font-family: var(--sans, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink-2, #55555e); margin-left: 0.3rem; } .ds-install-copied:empty::before { content: 'copy'; }

components.name: Transport
components.description: Play, back and next at the head of the key; play inverts to ink while pressed.
components.css: .ds-transport { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.8rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d0); } .ds-play, .ds-stepper { font: inherit; font-family: var(--sans, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #1c1c20); background: var(--plate, #fcfcfa); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1c20); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-play { padding: 0.42rem 0.9rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-play:hover, .ds-stepper:hover:enabled { background: var(--code-bg, #f1f1ec); } .ds-play[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #1c1c20); color: var(--plate, #fcfcfa); } .ds-stepper { width: 2.2rem; height: 2.2rem; padding: 0; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; } .ds-stepper svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-stepper:disabled { color: var(--ink-2, #55555e); border-color: var(--rule, #d6d6d0); cursor: default; } .ds-play:focus-visible, .ds-stepper:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slate, #3d5a80); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Key entry
components.description: A ruled row in the key: a numbered disc, a bold what and a quieter how. The lit entry's disc fills leaf.
components.css: .ds-key { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: var(--sans, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c20); } .ds-key li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d0); } .ds-key button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; width: 100%; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.62rem 0.3rem 0.62rem 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; line-height: 1.38; } .ds-key button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slate, #3d5a80); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disc { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.45rem; height: 1.45rem; margin: 0.1rem 0.7rem 0 0; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #1c1c20); border-radius: 50%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; flex: none; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-what { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-key button:hover .ds-what { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule, #d6d6d0); text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-how { grid-column: 2; color: var(--ink-2, #55555e); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.1rem; } .ds-lit .ds-disc { background: var(--leaf, #3f7a3b); border-color: var(--leaf, #3f7a3b); color: #fff; }

components.name: Running head
components.description: The header on every page: serif wordmark, small-caps links, a rule beneath.
components.css: .ds-running-head { padding: 1.1rem 0 0.9rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d0); display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--ink, #1c1c20); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: var(--serif, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.35rem; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: inherit; } .ds-running-head nav { display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; font-family: var(--caps, var(--sans, sans-serif)); font-variant: small-caps; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-running-head nav a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-2, #55555e); } .ds-running-head nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c1c20); } .ds-running-head a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slate, #3d5a80); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Prose link
components.description: Links in reading text: ink with a rule-coloured underline that darkens on hover.
components.html: The provider guide walks through one from start to finish.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: var(--serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink, #1c1c20); margin: 0; } .ds-prose a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule, #d6d6d0); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-prose a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-prose a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slate, #3d5a80); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The Plate in the Reference Book
narrative.overview:
The site is a reference book open at a plate: a house cut in section, drawn in ink on a white sheet, with the rooms tinted by an illustrator's washes and numbered callouts that match a key. The drawing is the page. Everything else on the site is the same book seen at other pages: a running head and a folio on every page, plate titles in a serif with a point of view, a key and tables set in the book's sans, room names and column heads in its small caps. The prose reads at 18px in a text serif because the visitor is reading, not scanning a pitch.

Colour is spent as a plate maker spends it. Ink and paper do nearly all the work. Brick red is what the section cut through, so only the walls carry it. Slate blue is the sound and the machines that hear it: microphones, the Mac's screen, the dotted route the sentence travels. Leaf green is the garden line, the dot in the mark, and whichever callout is lit; nothing else is green. The dark scheme is the same plate at night: a warm ink ground with pale line work and the washes dimmed to the same hues, not a second palette.

Depth is drawn, never lit. Rules separate things; boxes do not contain them. The only bordered surfaces are the plate's hairline frame, the install control, the transport buttons and code blocks, and every one is a hairline in ink or rule colour with at most a 2px corner. Everything shipped is SVG and CSS; there are no rasters, no gradients and no shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One drawing is the subject; the page is built around the plate, its key and its callouts.
Rules, not boxes: hairlines separate; nothing is carded, lifted or shadowed.
Ink on paper carries the page; brick, slate and leaf each have one job.
One superfamily (Alegreya, Alegreya Sans, Alegreya Sans SC) for display, prose, key and labels; monospace only inside commands.
Line work at fixed weights in SVG user units; on a phone the plate pans rather than shrinks.
Motion is the sentence travelling: dashes move, a disc settles, a sound line breathes, and all of it stops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Spend Rule
rules.body: Leaf green marks what is lit or what is alive: the current callout, the garden, the mark's dot. If green appears anywhere that is not one of those, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Poché Rule
rules.body: Brick is what the section cut through and nothing else. Floors, roof and stair are solid ink; walls are brick with an ink outline.

rules.name: The Sound Is Slate Rule
rules.body: Anything that hears or carries sound is slate: microphones, arcs, the route, the screen. Slate is a drawing colour and a focus ring, never text.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif for what is read, sans for what is consulted, small caps for what names a place or a column. Do not add a fourth face.

rules.name: The Mono Is A Command Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only inside code. It is never used for labels, kickers, numbers or emphasis.

rules.name: The Italic Is A Label Rule
rules.body: Italics on the plate name things ("the Mac", "Hey Parlour", "800 ms of quiet"). In prose, italics are the face's own and are not a display device.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If a surface needs separating, rule it; if it needs attention, light it in leaf.

rules.name: The Line Weight Is Depth Rule
rules.body: On the plate, nearness is stroke width, in SVG user units that do not scale with the page.

dos: Do separate with hairlines in rule colour (1px); close a list or a table body with a rule, not a box.
Do spend leaf on exactly one thing at a time: the lit callout, the current page, the garden line.
Do draw new figures as SVG with the plate's conventions: ink line at 2 units with round caps, plate fills, slate for sound, brick for cut walls, small caps for place names, a "Fig." caption beneath.
Do set anything that names a place or a column in true small caps (Alegreya Sans SC), ink 2, 0.06em tracked.
Do keep controls as 1px ink boxes on plate with a 2px corner, hover to code bg, pressed to inverted ink.
Do define any new colour in both :root and the dark override; the night plate is the same tokens, dimmed.
Do keep the reading measure at 62ch on the front page and 44rem in the docs.
Do let a drawing pan on a phone rather than shrink its line weights.
donts: Don't add shadows, blur, gradients or a raster image; the site ships none.
Don't put a tinted background behind a block of content; washes belong to rooms on a drawing, not to sections of a page.
Don't use leaf, slate or brick as text or link colour, or leaf as a button.
Don't introduce a fourth face or fake small caps with text-transform: uppercase.
Don't add a kicker, eyebrow or badge above a heading; the plate title stands alone and sheet titles are one serif line.
Don't card the key, the tables or the notes; they are ruled rows.
Don't animate anything that is not the sentence travelling, and never outside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
